description.en: The list of custom field objects.

description.zh: 账户展示名称，长度最大限制256字符。
description.en: The display name of the account. The name can be up to 256 characters in length.

description.zh: 邮箱，邮箱前缀可包含大写英文字母、小写英文字母、数字、点、下划线或中划线。
description.en: The email address. The prefix of the email address can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 邮箱是否验证，邮箱若设置此字段必须设置，无特殊业务可直接设置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether the email address is verified. This parameter is required if an email address is specified. If no special business requirements exist, set this parameter to true.
The phone number. The value must be 6 to 15 digits in length.

description.zh: 手机号是否验证，为可信手机号，手机号若设置此字段必须设置，无特殊业务可直接设置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether the phone number is verified as a trusted phone number. This parameter is required if a phone number is specified. If no special business requirements exist, set this parameter to true.

description.zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +, 手机号若设置，此参数必填。
description.en: The phone region code. Example: 86 for the Chinese mainland, without the 00 or + prefix. This parameter is required if a phone number is specified.

description.zh: 账户名称，可包含英文字母、数字、符号“_” 、“ .”、“@”、“-”，长度最大限制256。
description.en: The account name. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), at signs (@), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 256 characters in length.

title.zh: 更新一个EIAM账户基本信息
title.en: Update the basic information of an EIAM account

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-user --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --username username_test --display-name test_name --phone-region 86 --phone-number 156xxxxxxxxx --phone-number-verified true --email example@example.com --email-verified true --custom-fields FieldValue=test_value Operation=add FieldName=nick_name --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateUser --region cn-hangzhou --EmailVerified true --CustomFields.1.FieldName nick_name --Email 'example@example.com' --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --Username username_test --PhoneNumberVerified true --UserId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --DisplayName test_name --PhoneNumber 156xxxxxxxxx --CustomFields.1.Operation add --CustomFields.1.FieldValue test_value --PhoneRegion 86 --method POST --force
